description: Per-persona generation cost for the claude_* models, MEASURED on OpenRouter rather than read from their own run telemetry. Those runs used the Claude Code CLI, whose cost is not comparable with any other model in the grid: measured 2026-08-21, the CLI ships a ~27,000-token harness prompt on every call and runs with extended thinking, so 94% of billed output is reasoning rather than the answer -- a call returning {"value": "Sweden"} (18 tokens) billed 289. The same work costs 21x less through the API. The CLI runs also never persisted their cache-token counts, so their true input is unrecoverable. Rather than price a number known to be wrong, or leave a third of the grid absent, each claude_* combination is priced from a calibration run of the SAME model and method through OpenRouter. This is a reproduction cost -- what this work costs to run today on a comparable API -- not what the original runs were billed. It therefore carries its own cost_basis and must never be summed with generated_pool_01_raw figures as one spend total.

provenance.method: 10 personas generated per (model x method) through OpenRouter with the same strategy configs as the graded runs; cost = input*rate_in/1e6 + output*rate_out/1e6
